note: Extracted from docs/DECISIONS.md §4.1-4.5. The vocabulary is derived bottom-up from the scripts it must serve, then rounded to a tensor-parallel-friendly multiple. None of this derivation reached a page; only the final number did.

scope.why_perso_arabic: Dropping Urdu to stay Brahmic-only is the most conspicuous omission an India-first model can make. Perso-Arabic costs about 8,000 slots and covers Urdu, Sindhi and Kashmiri.

comparison.note: Output projection costs 2 x d_model x V FLOPs per token. At d_model 6,144 the total forward is about 80 GFLOP/token.

upper_bound: 262K buys about 53,000 more slots with no script left to serve. Gemma needs it for 140+ languages; a 12-script tokenizer does not.
embedding_note: Kronecker factorisation replaced a ~537M-parameter table with a 33.55M projection at 131K vocab, so the input embedding largely stops mattering. The vocabulary decision rests on softmax and output-projection compute, not embedding parameters — the part most analyses get backwards.
caveat: The 2.4 to 1.85 fertility figures behind the trade are estimated. The measurement run replaces them with observations for the tokenizers that exist; the candidate at 208,896 has never been trained, so its own fertility remains unmeasured.
